india.one_line: India sees new multilingual speech AI, AI law draft, global AI ties, and industrial AI lab launch.

themes.title: Chariot releases multilingual speech model
themes.text: Chariot introduced Chariot‑1‑ASR Realtime, a speech‑to‑text system covering ten Indian languages with lower error rates on 79 public test sets.

stories.headline: Chariot launches real‑time speech model for 10 Indian languages

themes.title: India prepares AI law draft
themes.text: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced a consultation paper on AI legislation will be released in the coming weeks, seeking input from society, citizens and industry.

stories.headline: India to issue AI law consultation paper in coming weeks, says minister

themes.title: India expands AI collaborations abroad
themes.text: Tech Mahindra partnered with SpaceXSI to offer AI‑assisted software engineering, while Poland’s prime minister urged deeper AI, digital and space cooperation with Indian firms.

stories.headline: Tech Mahindra partners with SpaceXSI to boost AI‑assisted software engineering
Polish prime minister calls for deeper AI, digital and space cooperation with India

themes.title: LTM opens AI lab in Chennai
themes.text: LTM launched the BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai to enable clients and partners to develop, simulate and validate AI solutions for industrial operations.

stories.headline: LTM launches BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai
